svg.text: Dense rows with an author column on every row, so attribution never depends on scrolling; a Compact / Detailed switch and an agent filter.
Updated its plan: 3 of 5 steps done

text.tspan: Make Activity and Handoffs readable, like

svg.text: Agent filter (a menu, for ten agents and
more) and the Compact / Detailed switch.
Compact: one line per row; ▸ opens the row
in place. Detailed opens every row.
A command shows its first line; opened, it
wraps and is coloured, as in A.
Opened rows add team and role under the
author, and render the whole Markdown.
Chip and name on every row: nothing to
scroll for, at the cost of repetition.
Handoffs as a table; one row opens at a time.
At 390 wide the author column folds into a line above each row (chip and name), so rows grow to two lines.
Densest of the three: about twice today’s rows on screen in Compact.
